ci.scope: Full unit suite, key-free demo, both offline reconstructions and full-history publication audit. This receipt is added after that exact passing source checkpoint.

limitations: Difficulty is supported by substantive errors in some cases, with a financial and recomputation ceiling for reserve/supply cases. This does not establish a general model ranking.
The evidence-only correction follows exposure and is applied to every unchanged evaluation answer, alongside the original scores.
Retry capture is best effort. Six additional attempts were observed, capture completeness is unproven and provider-internal retries are unknown.
Actual global pair order differs from the frozen listing. All slots, declared within-pair order and serial execution are verified.
Foreign-fork dispatch was not performed. Maintainer paths and fork repository-selection/permissions guards were tested.
Future model runs repeat published cases under the original canonical contract. The separate corrected review is bound to this original 54-slot manifest.
The candidate can read its dedicated capped inference key. Native TCP restrictions retain DNS/ICMP channels. The verifier has no inference key, network or Docker socket.
Provider deltas are observed accounting, not exact model allocations. Actions invoice/storage charges remain unknown.
